message.jaymoskingdoms.allay.shy: The allay shies away from you
message.jaymoskingdoms.allay.friend: The allays will speak of you in the Sylvan havens
talk.jaymoskingdoms.allay.thanks.0: You let it go. The woods will hear of that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.allay.thanks.1: Off home with it, little singer. Thank you, friend.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.allay.thanks.2: They kept it in there to carry their plunder. Not any more.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.allay.thanks.3: Listen to it sing. That's a thank you, that is.
